subject: general
question: The compound interest on ₹20,000 in 2 years at a 4% per year, the interest being compounded half-yearly, will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹20,000

Rate of interest (R) = 4% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

Interest is compounded half-yearly

**Formula used:**

Amount (A) for compound interest compounded half-yearly is given by:

A = P × (1 + R/2 × 100)²T

Where, R/2 is the rate per half year and 2T i
